The '''53rd [[Golden Globe Awards]]''', honoring the best in film and television for 1995, were held on January 21, 1996 at [[The Beverly Hilton]] and were televised on [[NBC]] in the [[United States]].<ref>{{cite news|last1=Dutka|first1=Elaine|last2=Puig|first2=Claudia|title='Sense,' 'Babe' Take Home Top Golden Globes|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1996-01-22-mn-27442-story.html|access-date=13 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=22 January 1996}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Golden Globe Awards closes gala event with som "Sense and Sensibility"|url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?id=ur4qAAAAIBAJ&sjid=6nwEAAAAIBAJ&pg=6856,2989241&dq=golden+globe+awards+sense+and+sensibility&hl=en|access-date=13 January 2018|work=Sarasota Herald-Tribune|via=Google News Archive|date=22 January 1996}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Miller|first1=Michael|title=Hollywood Left Guessing After Golden Globe Awards|url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?nid=1241&dat=19960122&id=O3RTAAAAIBAJ&sjid=JIYDAAAAIBAJ&pg=6494,672318&hl=de|via=Google News Archive|access-date=13 January 2018|work=Daily News|date=22 January 1996}}</ref> The nominations were announced on December 21, 1995.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Welkos|first1=Robert|last2=Dutka|first2=Elaine|title='Sense' Tops Globe Nod List With Six|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1995-12-22-ca-16723-story.html|access-date=13 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=22 December 1995}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Film, TV Nominees for the Golden Globes|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1995-12-22-ca-16740-story.html|access-date=13 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=22 December 1995}}</ref>
